enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body still. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to other side. Move arm. Sigh. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and plate. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Toast bread in toaster. Remove toast. Place eggs on plate. Pour tea into cup. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Finish eating. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag.

Walk out of apartment. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination, emails and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone call. Talk on phone. Write notes. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Return to desk. Sit down. Review documents. Make more calls.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Check phone. Finish eating. Stand up. Bus table. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office, planning upcoming community events and meeting volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open event planning document. Type notes. Make phone call. Meet with volunteer. Discuss event details. Shake hands. Walk to meeting room. Set up projector. Present plan. Answer questions. Return to desk. Send emails. Print flyers. Organize materials.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor. Put away ingredients. Wipe stove. Take out trash. Tie trash bag. Carry trash to door.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and reviewing notes for tomorrow's program
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up notes. Read notes. Highlight important points. Put down notes. Watch TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with phone, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Scroll through apps. Read messages. Reply to messages. Watch video. Put down phone. Turn off light. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to side. Sleep.
